before: Introduced Data Center Construction by Foreign Adversaries Act would bar construction by a foreign company unless ICC, IPA and DCEO jointly study consumption and certify the specified self-generated-load and PJM/MISO conditions. The definition includes an entity at least 51% owned by a foreign adversary or headquartered in a country governed by one.
after: Introduced Data Center Construction by Foreign Adversaries Act would bar a foreign company from constructing or causing construction of a data center unless ICC, IPA and DCEO jointly study its energy consumption and certify to the Governor and General Assembly that estimated energy use is a self-generated load and does not affect the PJM or MISO load supply. A foreign company is one at least 51% owned by a foreign adversary or headquartered in a country whose government is a foreign adversary, as defined by reference to 15 CFR 791.2.
